finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_top_decile_amount_event_spacing_entropy_25g
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The complete library measures amount mass, clock moments, local peaks, a global peak, threshold runs, adjacent path variation and weak-order triples, but does not reduce the day to a fixed count of top-decile liquidity events and measure the distribution of empty clock gaps between them. The statistic uses only accepted local amount and clock fields, discards magnitudes after event selection, and needs no provider request, price, or return.
